description: This file contains unit tests for the KeyValueType and TextKeyValueType classes in the WPEFramework project, using Google Test framework. It tests class construction, copy, assignment, and comparison operators, as well as some specific methods.

classes.name: KeyValueType
classes.description: A generic key-value pair class template used for storing key/value data.

classes.name: TextFragment
classes.description: A class representing a fragment of text, likely for use as a key component.

classes.name: TextKeyValueType
classes.description: A template class pairing a text fragment with a value, with case sensitivity option.

methods.name: KeyValueType::KeyValueType
methods.description: Constructors for different ways of initializing the key-value pair.

methods.name: KeyValueType::operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator for copying key-value pairs.

methods.name: KeyValueType::Key
methods.description: Returns the key part of the pair.

methods.name: KeyValueType::Value
methods.description: Returns the value part of the pair.

methods.name: KeyValueType::IsKey
methods.description: Checks if the stored key matches a given string.

methods.name: TextFragment::TextFragment
methods.description: Constructor for TextFragment given a string.

methods.name: TextKeyValueType::TextKeyValueType
methods.description: Constructors for the text key-value type, with optional case sensitivity.
